title: World Card Making Day: what it costs to mail a card in 2026
dek: World Card Making Day falls on the first Saturday in October. A Forever stamp now costs 82 cents, so here is what to know before you mail.
keyPoints: World Card Making Day is the first Saturday in October, which is October 3 this year.
A Forever stamp has cost 82 cents since July 12, 2026, up from 78 cents.
A domestic postcard stamp is 65 cents, and each additional ounce for a letter is 29 cents.

sources.title: What is World Card Making Day? (The Best Day EVER!) - Stampin' Up Blog
USPS 2026 Postage Rate Increase: Forever Stamp Rising to 82¢ on July 12

body: Today is World Card Making Day, which always falls on the first Saturday in October. Crafters mark it by making cards with paper, stamps and ink, and some companies host free virtual events where you can follow along with a demonstration.

You do not need special supplies to take part. A folded piece of cardstock, a few markers and a short handwritten note can make a card someone keeps for years. October is also a good time to get a head start on birthday cards for the rest of the year or on cards for the holidays.

If you plan to mail what you make, postage has gone up this year. Since July 12, 2026, a Forever stamp costs 82 cents, up from 78 cents. Domestic postcards now cost 65 cents to mail, and each additional ounce on a letter is 29 cents. Forever stamps you already own are still good at the new rate, no matter what you paid for them.

Thick, layered handmade cards can weigh more than an ounce, so it is worth checking the weight of one finished card before you buy stamps for a whole batch. A kitchen scale works, or a post office counter can weigh it for you.
If you make just one card today, pick someone who would not expect it. A surprise in the mailbox tends to mean the most.
